<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="20" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
    <line x1="322" y1="15" x2="326" y2="11" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="15" x2="332" y2="9" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="15" x2="338" y2="7" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="12" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="12" x2="353" y2="15" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="7" width="19" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367" y="9" width="14" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="385" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="28,54 20,62 28,70" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="45" y="68" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Order confirmation</text>
    <line x1="362" y1="55" x2="374" y2="67" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="374" y1="55" x2="362" y2="67" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Success illustration -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="167" r="73" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="167" r="54" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="167" r="39" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="174,167 188,181 218,149" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="121" cy="127" r="5" fill="#ADD993"/>
    <circle cx="268" cy="137" r="4" fill="#5DB075"/>
    <circle cx="131" cy="208" r="3" fill="#B3E5C8"/>
    <circle cx="260" cy="211" r="6" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Confirmation copy -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="278" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Order placed successfully!</text>
    <text x="195" y="308" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Thank you, Maya. Your homemade meal</text>
    <text x="195" y="329" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">is being prepared with care.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Order details card shadow and card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="23" y="359" width="344" height="145" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="23" y="357" width="344" height="145" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="43" y="383" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Order details</text>
    <rect x="277" y="369" width="70" height="24" rx="12" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <text x="312" y="385" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#267347">CONFIRMED</text>
    <line x1="43" y1="397" x2="347" y2="397" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="43" y="422" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Order number</text>
    <text x="347" y="422" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">#MF-48291</text>
    <text x="43" y="447" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Placed on</text>
    <text x="347" y="447" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">July 27, 2026 · 9:41 AM</text>
    <text x="43" y="476" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Estimated delivery</text>
    <text x="347" y="476" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Today, 12:30–1:00 PM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Delivery progress -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="535" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Your delivery is on its way</text>
    <text x="366" y="535" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5DB329">20%</text>
    <rect x="24" y="548" width="342" height="8" rx="4" fill="#E6EBF2"/>
    <rect x="24" y="548" width="68" height="8" rx="4" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <circle cx="92" cy="552" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="24" y="577" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Kitchen is preparing your order</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="600" width="342" height="60" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="24" y="598" width="342" height="60" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="195" y="635" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">TRACK YOUR ORDER</text>
    <polyline points="315,627 322,634 315,641" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Secondary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="674" width="342" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="704" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4B9460">VIEW ORDER DETAILS</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="39,787 49,779 59,787" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="42" y="786" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="49" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Home</text>
    <!-- Orders active -->
    <rect x="125" y="780" width="17" height="20" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="129" y1="786" x2="138" y2="786" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="129" y1="791" x2="138" y2="791" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="129" y1="796" x2="135" y2="796" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="133" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Orders</text>
    <!-- Community -->
    <rect x="207" y="781" width="20" height="14" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="211,795 211,800 216,795" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="213" cy="788" r="1.2" fill="#999999"/>
    <circle cx="218" cy="788" r="1.2" fill="#999999"/>
    <circle cx="223" cy="788" r="1.2" fill="#999999"/>
    <text x="217" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Community</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="333" cy="786" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="333" cy="783" r="2.5" fill="#999999"/>
    <ellipse cx="333" cy="791" rx="5" ry="3" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="333" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
